author: KEXP
description:
Spain’s Queralt Lahoz captivates audiences with an infectious blend of Latin folk, hip-hop, and dancehall. Drawing on her heritage and flamenco roots, she shares a performance of “LA FE” and more Live on KEXP in Bilbao. 

Watch the full remote session and interview with host Albina Cabrera on our channel now.
title: Queralt Lahoz - "LA FE" - Live on KEXP in Bilbao
